name: rare-structure-hq
description: Rare Structure HQ monorepo — design-system foundation

scripts.build: bun run --filter @rare-structure-hq/tokens build && bun run --filter @rare-structure-hq/ui build && bun run --filter marketing-site build && bun run --filter marketing-site-ao build && bun run --filter platform-app build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/tokens --noEmit && tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && tsc -p packages/eslint-plugin-rare-structure-hq --noEmit && tsc -b apps/marketing-site --noEmit && tsc -b apps/marketing-site-ao --noEmit && tsc -b apps/platform-app --noEmit
scripts.lint: bun run --filter eslint-plugin-rare-structure-hq build && biome check packages/tokens packages/ui packages/shared packages/eslint-plugin-rare-structure-hq apps/marketing-site/src apps/marketing-site-ao/src apps/platform-app/src eslint.config.mjs && bun x eslint apps/*/src/routes/**/*.tsx
scripts.test: bun run --filter @rare-structure-hq/shared test && bun run --filter @rare-structure-hq/tokens test && bun run --filter eslint-plugin-rare-structure-hq test && bun run --filter @rare-structure-hq/ui test && bun run --filter platform-api test && bun run --filter platform-app test
